title: One pre-norm block, in order
summary: Order the operations a token's vector goes through in a pre-norm decoder block.

items.text: Apply the feed-forward network (for example SwiGLU)
Normalize the residual stream for attention (RMSNorm)
Add the feed-forward output back to the residual stream
Causal self-attention over this and earlier positions
Normalize the residual stream for the feed-forward network (RMSNorm)
Add the attention output back to the residual stream
